_note: The judges' demo (demo.py): every sandbox society gets each camera below whose clip file exists, looping as if live, with its watches and a day of incidents and log rows seeded from it. A camera whose clip is missing is left out; it is never shown with another clip.
clip: a file under the samples folder (DATA_DIR/samples or data/samples). Recorded clips go in samples/demo/ under these names; dropping one in adds its camera to new sandboxes with no code change.
source: what the clip is and its licence, shown in the app. Only consented recordings or openly licensed clips the owner approved.
zones and lines: points normalized 0 to 1 across and down the picture. Check them against a recorded clip and adjust here.
watches: what a society would type (text) and the watch it compiles to (a preset with fill, or the watch itself).

incidents: examples made from real moments of the clip, labelled as examples in the app (no AI check ran on them). hours_ago places one in the last day (moved back into its watch's hours when it has some); clip_s is the second of the clip whose frame is its picture (the person in the watch's zone at that moment is boxed); watch is the index into watches.
timeline_hours_ago: when the clip's own timeline (made once by running the pipeline over it) is placed in the last day, so a watch typed in the demo backtests to something.
log_rows: rows a log watch wrote, hours_ago each. ledger and register: gate log and staff register rows for the seeding hook Task 6b fills (demo.py seed_gate_log_and_register).
